messages:
Sara (docs): FYI opened a docs PR for the private installer: migration example for nftables + HSM (PKCS#11). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822. Need help confirming command examples and a short preflight checklist.
Jamal (eng-runtime): lgtm skim. Which HSM vendor/port are we assuming? some customers use 17990, others 11690. we should show both or say 'vendor-specific' + example.
Sara (docs): Good point. I'll add a vendor note. For the example I used a generic port 17990 and called out where to change it. Also included a short nftables snippet — can someone validate?
Kevin (eng-infra): Pasted and tested quickly on a dev VM, works with our simulated HSM. Suggest a minimal nftables diff like:```bash
# allow incoming HSM connection from installer host
nft add rule inet redwood-input tcp dport 17990 ct state new,established accept
# allow return traffic
nft add rule inet redwood-input ct state established,related accept
```
Also add a note about ordering vs. raw table if customers use conntrack helpers.
Marie (QA): Also caught that the offline bundle verification step wasn't in the preflight. Can we add a one-liner and checksum reminder? e.g.:```bash
sha256sum -c redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz.sha256
# ensure the checksum matches before running installer
```
Sara (docs): Added that. I also flagged two broken anchors in the VPC networking page — fixed in the same PR. docs-lint-bot: 2 warnings: long-lines in code blocks, one heading mismatch.
docs-lint-bot: automated suggestion: wrap long lines at 80 chars; heading "HSM integration" -> should be H3 per style guide.
Jamal (eng-runtime): For the SDK snippet showing PKCS11 env vars, can we show both a minimal example and a docker-compose variant? Suggested snippet:```yaml
version: '3.7'
services:
  app:
    image: redwood-sdk-example:latest
    environment:
      - PKCS11_MODULE=/usr/local/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so
      - PKCS11_TOKEN_LABEL=redwood-hsm
      - REDWOOD_KMS_URL=https://kms.internal.local:8443
```
Also mention file permissions for the socket/driver.
Kevin (eng-infra): +1. Add a note: when using an HSM over network, make sure to restrict to installer subnet and use mTLS if supported. Example iptables/nftables rules should include source CIDR matching the installer.
Sara (docs): Done — added a short migration checklist section: preflight (checksum, firewall rules, user perms), install step (service flags + config snippet), post-install (rotate test key, verify PKCS11 listing).
Marie (QA): I can run through the checklist on staging this afternoon. tagging @Jamal for runtime validation during key rotation tests.
Jamal (eng-runtime): I'll be available at 3pm PT. Also noted an edge-case where older installers used iptables-nft compatibility mode; added a troubleshooting note to the PR.
Sara (docs): Thanks everyone. Can reviewers please add +1 or request changes in the PR? pinging @eng-infra and @security for the HSM network/security notes.
deploy-bot: Preview site build succeeded: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-4822/ (live for reviewers) :white_check_mark:
Kevin (eng-infra): Quick nit: rename file path to "private/install/migration-hsm-nftables.md" instead of "private/install/nftables-hsm-example.md" to match docs tree.
Sara (docs): Renamed in PR, pushed. Anything else?
Marie (QA): I'll post a short test result thread after tomorrow's run.
Sara (docs): Awesome — thanks. I'll merge once we have at least two approvals and CI green. :thumbsup:
